historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir records the name Basam b. Abd al-Muttalib as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad during the Treaty of Hudaybiya in 628 CE.

historical_references.reference: Al-Tabari relates that Basam was a brother of Umar ibn Al-Khattab and a prominent Sahabi (companion) of the Prophet Muhammad, playing a role in the Battle of Uhud in 625 CE.
